title: Restriction for a constant pushforward
statement: Let T be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space], let T_0 be a closed subset (hence locally closed in the sense of [def-weil-locally-closed-subset]), and suppose every irreducible closed subset C of T [def-weil-irreducible-components] meets C intersect T_0 in a nonempty connected subset [def-weil-connected-scheme]. For a closed subset C of T with continuous inclusion i:C to T and an abelian group M, restriction induces a bijection Gamma(T,(i)_* underline{M}) to Gamma(T_0,(i)_* underline{M}|_{T_0}), where (i)_* is direct image along the continuous inclusion [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] and underline{M} is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves].
